title: Rafram bar Papa of Sikhra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 31b, where Rav Acha son of Rav Yosef asked Rav Ashi: do we require three handbreadths? And in response to this, Rafram bar Papa of Sichra said: one handbreadth.
In Bava Metzia 42a, the reading is only “Rafram of Sikhra,” with the patronymic bar Papa omitted.

Hyman writes that he found a valuable reading in Dikdukei Soferim: “Rafram said: It stands to reason—a handbreadth.” Hyman concludes that he is in fact the unqualified Rafram who presided in the year תשמד (744), as discussed above.

notes.text: תשמד has the numerical value 744. This excerpt does not name the calendar era; the earlier draft’s 4840 was unsupported. The supplied ר״פ is retained in discussing the omitted patronymic.

The consulted Pesachim 31b names Rafram bar Pappa of Sikhra. The alternative מסתברא and the identification with the Rafram who presided are Hyman’s claims; the exact Dikdukei Soferim reading has not been directly inspected.
